anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, C1 is drawn as 0.1 µF / 16 V, hanging from the Display_Power_Switch (EPD booster input) node to GND, in parallel with C2 (1 µF / 6.3 V).
anomalies.expected: The specification's EPD match table asserts schematic C1 belongs to the PDI 'C2 default' group and must be 1 µF / 25 V ('C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V'). The build substitutes a 0.1 µF / 16 V part, so both the value (10× low) and the voltage rating (16 V vs 25 V) deviate from the intended reference design.

evidence.quote: C1 0.1uF/16V (EPD_Driver.kicad_sch, between Display_Power_Switch node and GND)
C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default

anomalies.impact: The EPD boost-converter input node loses its intended 1 µF bulk/25 V capacitor and instead has only a 0.1 µF/16 V bypass (the 1 µF/6.3 V C2 remains). This increases input ripple / reduces high-frequency decoupling at the booster input relative to the reference design and lowers the capacitor's voltage margin; it is a deviation in component value and rating rather than a documented known limitation.

parsed.summary: The schematic is otherwise a faithful implementation of the spec (all reference designators, part numbers, the FAN53610 regulator topology, the Q2 display power switch, the PDI EPD charge-pump parts, and the signal mappings match), but C1 on the EPD_Driver sheet is populated as 0.1 µF/16 V where the specification states it should be 1 µF/25 V, a value/rating deviation at the EPD booster input.
